title: Film Independent Classes, Filmmaker Tuesdays and IndieLink
summary: Film Independent runs seminars on screenwriting, distribution and festival strategy (Filmmaker Tuesdays, twice monthly) and IndieLink events with cinematographers, editors, composers and designers. The page says classes mostly take place in person in Los Angeles, but many are held online so members outside LA can take part.
dateText: Ongoing; see the schedule on the source
costLabel: Included with membership, per the source
